findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cross_asset_7y_forecast, get_100yr_backtest_summary · Public sink: get_cross_asset_7y_forecast, get_100yr_backtest_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cross_asset_7y_forecast, get_100yr_backtest_summary · Public sink: get_cross_asset_7y_forecast, get_100yr_backtest_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
